shared_elements: single elite human figure as the dominant subject
low-relief carving on a rectangular slab
frontal/profile depiction of an adorned dignitary
justification: Both show a single richly adorned high-status human figure with an elaborate headdress and ornamental details carved in low relief on an upright slab, but this is a very generic correspondence. A depicts a full standing frontal figure with feathered plumes, a pectoral, and blocks of dense sign-like glyph panels beside and below it, whereas B is a bust-length strict profile with a tall conical cap, curled beard rendered in rows of dots, earring and rosette-studded shoulder — different figure conventions, framing and no writing.
